company.name: NEXADE
company.shortDescription: NEXADE is a blockchain-powered trade finance and decentralized finance (DeFi) platform.
company.description: NEXADE is a blockchain-powered trade finance and decentralized finance (DeFi) platform focused on integrating Real World Assets (RWAs) into digital financial ecosystems. The company aims to modernize global trade finance by combining traditional asset-backed financing structures with decentralized infrastructure, enabling more efficient, transparent, and accessible cross-border commerce.
